profile.headline: SharePoint Evangelist at Freedom Consulting Group
profile.summary:
An Information Systems specialist with twenty one years experience. I earned a BS in Electrical Engineering then spent five years as a Communications and Information Officer in the United States Air Force. After I separated from the Air Force I became a defense contractor. I have worked in numerous positions as both a project leader and an individual contributor and earned a Masters of Business Administration with a concentration in management of technology to be more effective. I excel in a team environment and am highly adaptable seamlessly transitioning from one role to another as the situation demands. I am always seeking new challenges and opportunities.

Specialties: Microsoft SharePoint 2010, 2013, Microsoft 365, Microsoft SharePoint Designer 2007, 2010, & 2013, IT Project Management, Knowledge Management, Full Lifecycle Documentation.

positions.title: Sr. Systems Engineer
positions.description: Public face of a small, elite, and agile SharePoint 2013 and 2016 development team within, and serving, a large organization.  I lead efforts to define, design, develop, and deploy custom SharePoint solutions.  I am the point of contact for all troubleshooting questions for SharePoint Administrators across a large SharePoint 2013 enterprise.

positions.title: Associate
positions.description: Site Collection Administrator of a large, enterprise-wide SharePoint 2010 Site Collection.  Managed four SharePoint Administrators managing subservient SharePoint Sites.  Led the effort to review branding, permission groups, security settings to ensure they conform to SharePoint best practices and the organization's security guidelines.  I developed SharePoint solutions using custom web parts, javascript, HTML, and Infopath.  I also mentored less experienced SharePoint designers on best practices when building a site or portal.

positions.title: Systems Engineer II
positions.description: Designed two SharePoint Portals.  The first using SharePoint 2007 to create a portal for a proposal efforts, and the second using SharePoint 2010 to manage the business processes for large contract the department had won.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Joint Forces Command's Joint Knowledge Development and Distribution Capability (JKDDC) Liaison to Army Knowledge Online (AKO) and Defense Knowledge Online (DKO) at Ft. Belvoir.  Advocates the benefits of Joint Knowledge Online to AKO/DKO Leadership.

positions.title: Project Leader
positions.description: I accredited a IT network that had failed accreditation for one year.  To complete this project I had to overcome low team morale, solve personal conflicts between IT Team members, and remove political barriers to accreditation put in place by network users.  My success greatly increased the reputation of my company in the mind of the  contracting officer representative.

positions.title: Microsoft SharePoint Administrator
positions.description: I assisted in the design of cutting-edge Sharepoint portal for the Joint Improvised Explosive Device Defeat Organization.  During the process I advocated the benefits of the new SharePoint system and answered all customer questions regarding SharePoint use.  My efforts led to the eliminated long paper trails and misplaced critical data, and improved user satisfaction with simplified workflows using SharePoint.

positions.title: Proposal Manager
positions.description: Worked as a member on a $500 million dollar proposal to provide 78 individuals to the Department of Defense.  To complete the proposal I worked closely with both the Human Resources and Finance Department to determine ideal candidates and I vetted all candidates submitted by 15 subcontractors and provided up-to-the-minute candidate needs.  I designed a SharePoint site to streamline to proposal process.

positions.title: Communications and Information Officer
positions.description: Air Force Officer rising to the rank of Captain (O-3).  During my time in the Air Force I oversaw the installation of a Windows SharePoint Services v2.0 Server for the Commander's Action Group (CAG) at Air Combat Command HQ in 2006.  I was involved in network operations and software testing as well as preventing the compromise of sensitive data on classified systems as a flight Information Systems Security Officer.
